motion.statusLink: This page's link (?motion={url}) is holding {held} motion. Your choice applies once you leave it.
motion.statusSystemReduce: Your device asks for reduced motion, so the games are calm.
motion.statusSystemFull: Your device has no motion preference, so the games play in full.
motion.chipLinkAria: Motion and flashes: {held}, set by this page's link.
motion.titleReduced: Reduced: no flashes or shake, shorter hit-stops. Same game timing.
motion.titleFull: Full: flashes, shake and slow-mo on the big moments.
motion.heading: MOTION & FLASHES
motion.body: Reduced turns off screen flashes and camera shake in every game, and cuts hit-stops and slow-motion to a blink. Only the picture changes: every window, timer and score is the same. A slow-mo you are timing a press inside (the dunk's hang) keeps its length for that reason.

colorVision.title: COLOUR VISION
colorVision.body: Swaps the game HUD's colours for ones you can tell apart, and adds a pattern beside each colour cue: the perfect band hatched, the good band edged. Only colours and patterns change; every window, meter and score is the same.

couch.title: BIG-SCREEN MENUS
couch.body: On a TV, the menus grow to the size the game HUD is, so you can read them from the couch. Auto turns this on when a controller or a TV remote drives the menus on a big screen.
